concepts.title: Meta-Method Plasticity / Failure-to-Evolution Loop
concepts.derivation_reason: Verified collaboration failures should improve the method used to investigate, verify, route and experiment, not merely produce local patches.
concepts.universal_invariant: failure → classification → causal boundary → competing explanations → reusable method candidate → counterexample → verification → promotion/rejection → later reuse
concepts.next_open_edge: later contextual consumption of a verified method delta → changed future investigation/routing behavior

concepts.title: Capability Preservation and Context-Gated Sparse Activation
concepts.derivation_reason: A universal adaptive system should preserve a broad capability repertoire while activating only the subset justified by the current objective and constraints.
concepts.universal_invariant: broad capability preservation + context-conditioned activation + governed realization selection
concepts.next_open_edge: verified runtime reuse of dormant capability knowledge when a later objective makes the capability relevant

concepts.title: Governed Self-Code Evolution / Capability-Oriented Code Plasticity
concepts.derivation_reason: The near-term developmental inflection is reached when verified experience can drive bounded, reversible evolution of IABV's own code while preserving the broader capability repertoire.
concepts.universal_invariant: verified deficit → required capability → existing-organ archaeology → isolated code evolution → baseline/candidate verification → governed promotion/rejection/rollback → capability/method/relation/routing delta → later contextual reuse
concepts.next_open_edge: verified improvement proposal → isolated executable code variant → baseline/candidate comparison → independent verification → governed production-code promotion

concepts.title: Independent Trust Bootstrap and Exact-Instance Evidence Boundary
concepts.derivation_reason: A trust-bootstrap route must establish independent evidence provenance, Owner authority, TPM/issuer binding, exact server-instance binding, independent reader verification and revocation as separate edges. A plausible local mechanism is not enough.
concepts.universal_invariant: claim → provenance → independent identity verification → transaction-specific authority → protected credential binding → exact-instance binding → independent reader/revocation check → governed action
negative_knowledge: GitHub approval is not machine-claim verification.
A target-displayed EKPub fingerprint is not an independent identity source.
TPM key non-exportability is not exact running process identity.
Measured boot is not by itself arbitrary live-process attestation.
An allowlist without independently established initial contents relocates rather than solves bootstrap trust.
concepts.falsifier: New source evidence proves an already available independent TPM identity source and a separate, defensible exact-instance/reader-verification path without an unapproved trust root or excluded infrastructure.
concepts.next_open_edge: Owner decision on a distinct, bounded read-only assessment of existing trust assets; not authorized by the static design task.

concepts.title: Execution-to-Evidence Stage Separation and Projection Observability
concepts.derivation_reason: Repeated command receipts reported source success while the sanitized projection remained UNKNOWN; earlier corrective prompts did not contain a reproducible executable artifact or stage-specific capture diagnostics. The method must locate the earliest unproven evidence transition and prevent same-route repetition without a changed precondition.
concepts.problem_or_objective: Make cross-tool/OS actions causally observable without inferring success across execution, projection, transport, persistence or later reuse stages.
concepts.new_mechanism_or_distinction: Track objective/authority, destination, exact input, invocation, source result, output shape, field-level projection, serialization/transport, reconciliation, fetch-back and causal reuse independently; use bounded retry conditions and stage-local statuses.
concepts.affected_layer: coordination method, external-AI/tool handoff, OS command observation, evidence receipt, persistent memory
concepts.epistemic_status: DOCUMENTED_METHOD_NOT_RUNTIME_PROVEN; TPM root cause remains UNRESOLVED
concepts.evidence: Owner-supplied preflight receipts; source-grounded Microsoft Get-Tpm/Get-TpmEndorsementKeyInfo documentation; canonical TPM projection-capture static review
concepts.falsifier: A future correlated receipt proves a complete typed source result and safe projection existed but a downstream transport/sanitization stage changed it; revise causal localization to that stage while retaining stage separation.
concepts.knowledge_delta: A successful operation does not imply successful observation/projection; the missing stage determines one discriminating next action instead of a same-route repeat.
concepts.method_delta: Stage-specific receipt schema; per-field typed capture states; explicit corrective-artifact and authorization gates; no-repeat rule without a changed precondition.
concepts.routing_delta: Keep one active task; TPM preflight remains stopped; next action is Owner decision on one fixed capture run or closure of the branch.
concepts.next_open_edge: Owner decision followed, only if authorized, by one execution of the exact candidate capture with correlated receipt; later demonstrate reuse by a changed subsequent decision.

concepts.title: Verified Progress Utility, Strategy Switching, and Preparation-Debt Control
concepts.derivation_reason: The observed preparation-only blocker showed that anti-loop detection can still permit successive setup tasks without proof of target utility. The Owner then clarified that the developmental target includes all participating AI sessions using GitHub as shared external memory, not only IABV product/runtime. The method therefore needs both a target-edge utility gate and an explicit retrieve/activate/apply/verify/later-reuse contract across agents.
concepts.problem_or_objective: Improve the time and quality of shared human–AI and AI-to-AI work by ensuring verified repository memory changes current-session framing/routing and future cross-session decisions, rather than only accumulating documentation.
concepts.new_mechanism_or_distinction: Require an ADVANCE_CONTRACT and capability-surface comparison; mark preparation-only activity; require strategy reset after two preparation-only steps; and distinguish memory retrieved, method activated, method applied, outcome verified and later causal reuse for every material cross-AI decision.
dependencies_on_existing_organs: UAAL-D018 Execution-to-Evidence Stage Separation and Projection Observability
UAAL-D019 Space-Time Anti-Loop and First-Open Causal Frontier
concepts.affected_layer: shared external memory and cross-AI symbiosis, ChatGPT/Codex/other-agent task selection, Space-Time continuity, IABV architecture and future runtime transfer only after demonstrated reusable mechanisms
concepts.evidence: Owner/Codex-reported M1B setup blocker; observed assistant correction failure; live-main retrieval of UAAL-D020, Constitution §12, the living Space-Time protocol, SYMBIOSIS-MAP and shared developmental knowledge-field record; explicit Owner clarification of intended cross-AI scope. Independent causal contribution of stored memory remains unisolated.
concepts.falsifier: A later non-identical task shows the method adds repeated overhead without improving target-edge closure or decision-changing information gain, or a direct route selected under the method repeatedly fails while the supposedly necessary preparation proves avoidable.
concepts.knowledge_delta: Anti-loop avoidance must be paired with an exact-source evidence gate: local implementation, accessible final bytes, static review, executed tests, source publication, PR review and main fetch-back are distinct. For M1B, R1/R2 reviews caught target-match/schema flaws, R3 tightened timezone validation and Codex reported 34 targeted tests passing; source publication and independent confirmation remain outstanding.
concepts.method_delta: Advance contract and preparation-debt reset plus cross-AI memory activation ladder: MEMORY_RETRIEVED → METHOD_ACTIVATED → METHOD_APPLIED → OUTCOME_VERIFIED → LATER_CAUSAL_REUSE; explicit per-stage evidence and no claim of model-weight change. Add code evidence ladder LOCAL_CANDIDATE_REPORTED → EXACT_FINAL_SOURCE_AVAILABLE → STATIC_REVIEWED → TESTS_EXECUTED → SOURCE_PUBLISHED_BRANCH → PR_DIFF_REVIEWED → MAIN_FETCHBACK_VERIFIED; compare validators to live models and real artifact shapes; enforce timezone-aware timestamps; hashes alone never imply review or publication.
concepts.routing_delta: M1B applied the shared method: review supplied R1/R2 source, identify a concrete timezone edge, and require targeted test evidence. Avoid reimplementation/reclone; next publish exact R3 candidate to isolated code PR and review/hash-check exact diff. Test result remains OWNER_CODEX_REPORTED; bridge gates unchanged.
concepts.next_open_edge: Publish exact R3 local files in an isolated branch/PR, match published source to reported hashes, and independently review/fetch back the exact diff. Only then can M1B be considered published; G1/G2/G3 and bridge authorization remain separate open dependencies.
concepts.cross_ai_application_contract: For every material session using repository memory, track retrieval, activation, application, verified outcome and later causal reuse separately. Apply to ChatGPT, Codex and other participating agents when actual authorized context access exists. External memory is not model-weight training or proof of automatic delivery.
concepts.current_session_application: 2026-10-28: source review identified target-binding and partial-schema defects; follow-up found timezone-naive internal-date acceptance; Codex reported the narrow fix and 34 passing targeted tests. Exact R3 bytes and execution were not independently retrieved; no runtime or later causal reuse is proven.
